headline: 復活の混テキスト gains 13.89 on ARC-2

sections.text: 復活の混テキスト added 13.89 points to reach 58.33, moving from 51st to 31st on the ARC-AGI-2 board.
The team now sits 31st on the board, amid a busy day of movement across the field.
